title: Pure Brainrot
description: The best brainrot mod in existence. Adds and aura system, triple t, ksi, EsDeeKid music, looksmaxxing and more.
body:
Welcome to the Pure Brainrot Mod

Step into a chaotic, high-energy experience with the Pure Brainrot Mod, a content-packed expansion built to completely transform your world. This mod introduces new items, systems, bosses, music, and mechanics designed to push gameplay, atmosphere, and progression to the next level.

Features

Thick of It
Experience a denser, more intense atmosphere that adds depth and immersion to your surroundings.

Mango Phonk
A high-energy phonk soundtrack that sets the mood for exploration and combat.

Mangos
Harvest and collect mangos, a new resource with unique uses.

Still Water
New tranquil water variants that enhance environmental visuals.

KSI
Encounter KSI as a unique in-game entity featuring unexpected interactions.

Prime
A consumable feature that boosts gameplay and grants special benefits.

Balkan Rage
Unleash a powerful ability that dramatically increases intensity during combat.

Aura System
A full progression system that grants unique powers and enhancements as you grow stronger.

Looks Maxxing
Improve your character through training:

Mewing increases your Face Card level

Squatting increases your Gyatt level

67 Item
A new item that plays the iconic 67 sound when used.

Awakening System
Advance through four awakening ranks, each representing a new level of power:

Beta

Alpha

Sigma

Phonk Master

Tung Tung Tung Sahur Boss
Face a powerful new boss encounter featuring unique mechanics. Defeating it rewards the Heavenly Sahur Music Disc.

Music Discs Added

Phantom – EsDeeKid

4Raws – EsDeeKid

Century – EsDeeKid

Property in Egypt

Added a property in Egypt structure that spawns in deserts
Added a few new entities that don't spawn naturally it's just to help with the structure
Added a property in Egypt key to unlock the locked door and chest
